male_pct.evidence_source: [/page/5/Text/5] Facilitators (11 women and 2 men) were given articles describing results from the efficacy trials to introduce them to the major concepts involved in the CB group depression prevention program and asked to read the detailed intervention script.

Source.evidence_source: [/page/5/Text/6] Sessions were audiotaped and half were randomly selected for review by the first and third author for treatment adherence and competence, based on scales developed previously. Protocol adherence was measured using session-specific checklists for the concepts, skills, and exercises that are outlined in the session script.
